description: This file defines the class 'FlexibleStringExpander', which is used for expanding string values containing Unified Expression Language (UEL) syntax, supporting nested expressions and scripting (e.g., Groovy). It includes mechanisms for caching, parsing, and evaluating expressions with support for currency formatting and localization.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander
classes.description: An abstract class for expanding strings containing expressions, supporting nested expressions, scripting, currency formatting, and evaluation with localization and caching.

methods.name: containsConstant
methods.description: Checks if a FlexibleStringExpander contains a String constant.

methods.name: containsExpression
methods.description: Checks if a FlexibleStringExpander contains an expression.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks if a FlexibleStringExpander contains a script.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Evaluates an expression string within a context, locale, and timezone, returning the expanded string.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached FlexibleStringExpander instance based on the input expression.
